title: Driver for the chosen level sensor
goal: The agent reads the chosen level sensor in centimetres
acceptance: A binding variant, its case in drivers/hardware.ts and mock behaviour
A unit test with the bus mocked
A note in docs/DESIGN.md "Hardware" and a step in the bring-up guide
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: 2 h agent for a new I²C driver; option 1 (ADS1115) would need only the volts-to-cm calibration, about 1 h.
